Celsius Holdings go-to-market change e-commerce Amazon club channel 2026 third quarter

findings.claim: Pepsi 成為 Celsius、Alani Nu、Rockstar 在美加的主要經銷商；Alani Nu 原經銷商被終止、區域權利移轉給 Pepsi，Pepsi 補償終止費最多 2.75 億美元（遞延收入、約 17 年攤銷）。
findings.excerpt: In connection with expanding Pepsi’s distribution responsibilities to include Alani Nu, we terminated certain former Alani Nu distributors and transitioned territory rights to Pepsi. Pepsi agreed to reimburse us for distributor termination fees up to $275.0 million, to facilitate this transition.

findings.claim: 2026-05-21 修約再把部分前 Alani Nu 區域移給 Pepsi，Pepsi 補償 8,110 萬美元終止費（摘要轉述）。
findings.excerpt: A May 21, 2026 amendment moved more former Alani Nu territories to Pepsi. Pepsi agreed to reimburse $81.1 million in related distributor termination fees, and the company says it has now received and used all of that money.

findings.claim: 2026Q3 毛利率 46.8%（去年同期 51.3%），10-Q 歸因於通路組合（DSD 比重上升）與鋁、燃料成本；CELSIUS 品牌營收約 -6%，原因含 SKU 優化、庫存再平衡出貨時點與量販（club）通路疲弱。
findings.excerpt: The decrease in gross profit margin was primarily driven by channel mix, including a higher mix of DSD sales, and increased commodity costs, primarily aluminum and fuel.

note: 未找到訂閱化／D2C／平台化轉型證據；通路轉移為經銷體系集中於 Pepsi DSD。
